India is steadily closing the power gap with China, according to the 2026 Asia Power Index released by Australia's Lowy Institute. India scored 40.5 points, marking its narrowest gap with China since the index began in 2018 and consolidating its position as a major power in Asia.
The report also ranks Prime Minister Narendra Modi as Asia's second-most effective regional leader, behind Chinese President Xi Jinping. India's diplomatic influence, defence networks and cultural reach have strengthened, while its future power potential has also improved.
